holeBearingsHint: Compass bearings (0-360 deg) per hole, tee to green. OSM has no holes here (only a course outline; the nearby hole ways are Solmar). Derived by registering the Tour's 2026 overhead hole images (tee left, green right) against north-up satellite imagery, turf/sand correlation over rotation and scale, then solving the routing so each green leads to the next tee and 1/9/10/18 meet at the clubhouse. Checked by overlay on the fairways and by the diagrams' neighbouring features. Hole 16 was solved separately around its green at 348. Estimated accuracy about 5-10 degrees; holes 10-13 had the weakest image scores.
